## Context / Problem
The debug skill reads prior tickets but never writes back (reads from a well it never fills); Step 7 sweeps by construct only (parity siblings are ABSENCES invisible to grep); Reporting lets residual fragility evaporate. Approved changes 14+15+16 from the bug-trend review.

## Approach
(14) Writebacks: Phase-1-exit RCA comment (root cause + discriminating evidence); Reporting summary comment (cause/proof/test/fix/siblings/replication); not-a-bug classification comment + cited source; Step-7 siblings filed via create + discovered_from encoded DIRECTLY in the skill (no AGENTS.md reference — client projects may lack it). Tracker discriminator, stated inline in the skill: the tracker the debug session is already operating within — the one that produced or holds the ticket under debug — is "the project's own mandated tracker" and receives the prescribed writebacks un-gated; ANY other tracker is third-party and stays approval-gated. The existing approval-gate paragraph (SKILL.md "Seek explicit user approval… writing/transitioning/commenting on Jira or other trackers") is explicitly amended in the same change with a carve-out sentence so the prescribed own-tracker writebacks do not contradict it; all other tracker mutations remain gated. (15) Step 7 second sweep axis (construct search unchanged), decomposed into 4 forced-artifact questions: NAME THE RULE (operation+property, must not name the fixed site); CHANNEL CENSUS (fixed 5-slot checklist: CLI / MCP-API / library-facade / automated-callers / dual-direction, plus caller-set derivation — a surface absent from the shared core's callers is the parity signature); PER-SURFACE PROBE (cite path:line or MISSING); DISPOSITION (RED-test fix or ticket + discovered_from). Step 7's entry trigger is amended to the OR of the two axis triggers: enter when the root cause is a repeatable construct pattern (axis 1, existing wording) OR when the fixed code sits on one of several parallel surfaces (axis 2 — a parity sibling is an absence, present even for one-off constructs); each axis then runs only under its own condition. (16) Reporting item 'Residual risk & prevention': per observed-with-citation fragility, forced disposition — ticket filed (may propose structural guard) / accepted with reason / fixed in scope; 'none observed' legitimate; prose only, no new ticket-system structures.

## Scope
- examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md (single real file; ~35-45 lines total). SKILL.md has no symlink or synced copy — only shared/test-design.md is cp-synced across skills, and that file is untouched here.

## Testing
Prose-only skill change: no code tests. Validation = the existing skill sync gate (tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py, which covers shared/test-design.md only) run as a regression check confirming this change does not perturb the synced set, and a dry-run read-through against the 4-question artifacts on one historical bug (4b59 link-direction class).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All four writebacks encoded at their lifecycle points, with the inline own-tracker-vs-third-party discriminator AND the approval-gate paragraph amended with the matching carve-out (no contradiction between the two sections).
- [x] Step 7 carries both axes with the 4-question decomposition and forced artifacts, and its entry trigger is the OR of the two axis conditions.
- [x] Reporting carries the residual-risk disposition item with 'none observed' legitimate.
- [x] No references to AGENTS.md; discovered_from linkage stated inline.
